synopsis: Vinnova is associated with the Swedish EVIDENT program, which ran with SAFER from April 2022 to December 2024, about 33 months [f1553, f15710]. Its follow-on, EVIDENT 2, remained ongoing in 2026, with its record updated on 10 June 2026; the supplied facts give no completion date [f1556]. Vinnova and Drive Sweden also funded VaViM, which ran from February to August 2022 with Volvo Autonomous Solutions and Blekinge Institute of Technology [f15705, f1721]. VaViM studied validation of virtual models for autonomous vehicle systems operating in a fenced area, providing a distinct, shorter precedent alongside EVIDENT [f1721, f1553].

relations.note: Both report EVIDENT’s dates, approximately 33-month duration, and SAFER/Vinnova association.
